.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/creat.instruction: Run {{script}} <path> where <path> is the slash-separated command path (e.g. create/artifact), written exactly as it appears in the file location.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/list/.instruction: Run {{script}} [search term] with an optional search term argument to filter the listed commands by path.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/updat.instruction: Run {{script}} <command-path> to verify the command file exists before applying the update, exiting non-zero with an error if it does not.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/delet.instruction: Run {{script}} <path> where <path> is the command path exactly as it appears in the file location (e.g. create/artifact).
Run {{script}} <path> where <path> is the command's path exactly as it appears in its file location (e.g. create/artifact).

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/evalu.instruction: Run {{script}} <path>, where <path> is the command's slash-separated path exactly as it appears in its file location (e.g. create/artifact).

create.text: Scaffolds a new command file at src/commands/{path}.command.ts, given the path, exiting 1 if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists commands in src/commands matching an optional search term and prints each as command path plus file path.

update.text: Applies a natural-language change request to an existing command file at src/commands, given the command path and the change description, failing if the command file does not exist

delete.text: Deletes a command's file given its path, then finds and removes all dangling references to it in the codebase

evaluate.text: Checks that a command file has exactly the required help and default-export structure and delegates all logic to classes, given the command path as input.
